sections.Aims and Fit of Module: To provide a theoretical basis for the understanding of population ecology. To develop mathematical models to simulate and predict the behaviour of biological ecosystems involving (i) a single species, (ii) several interacting species
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Interpret the biological significance of the terms and parameters in a variety of population models of one species or several interacting species. B. Analyse discrete-time and continuous-time dynamical models in order to predict future changes in an ecosystem. C. Analyse how the behaviour of solutions of a model change as parameters are varied.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: This module will be delivered by a combination of formal lectures and tutorials.
